entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I never expected what happened to[n]Futaba's mother would be connected[n]to those incidents in the city.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, this is truly our time to shine!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Though this scoundrel has the same[n]power as us, they're triggering people's[n]mental shutdowns...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If they truly exist, who can stop them?[n]...Only us.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We've got a new addition to the team,[n]so it's time I flex my veteran skills!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We can't have you pussyfooting now.[n]Don't worry. I'll back you up with my[n]wealth of experience!
